name: TV Repair

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: TV repair at the shop
services.story: The main story: a TV with no picture dropped off; the $65 bench check is paid as a deposit when booking and counts toward the repair; the rest is paid at pick-up.

services.name: Game console HDMI port replacement
services.story: A game console HDMI port replaced for $129, nothing taken when booking, paid at pick-up.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer

services.name: TV repair at home
services.story: The main story: a 75-inch TV fixed at home; the $99 trip and check is promised; the repair is priced in the home; the saved card is charged at DONE.

services.name: TV wall mounting
services.story: A 65-inch TV mounted on the wall for $149; a card is saved; it's charged at DONE.

services.name: Warranty TV repair
services.story: A warranty repair at home: nothing taken; the plan is billed; Alex gets a bill only for anything it doesn't cover.

services_shape: repairs of TVs, sound systems, receivers, game consoles and projectors: carried in to the shop (dropped off, checked, priced, fixed, picked up) or, for big TVs, fixed in the home; TV wall mounting in the home
questions_before_times: at the shop or at your home
what it is (a TV, a sound bar, a receiver, a game console, a projector)
what's wrong (no power, no picture, lines, no sound, a broken screen)
under a warranty or a protection plan?
for mounting: the screen size, the wall (drywall, brick, plaster), your mount or ours
safety_stop: smoke, sparks, flames or a burning smell from a TV or device
a battery that is swollen, hot, hissing or leaking (a remote, a controller, a sound bar)
a TV that fell, or someone hurt under a TV or stand
water or a drink spilled into a plugged-in device
an old tube TV opened at the back
license: A business registration; where the state's rules require an electronic repair dealer registration, the business says its number (its own word) before it goes live.
staff_skills: ["bench repair","in-home TV repair","wall mounting","warranty work for the brands the business is authorized for"]
messages_never: ["device passcodes or account passwords","what's on the customer's device","gate or building codes","the card"]
